segmente.text: This is the most important rule in marketing. You don't sell the product, you sell emotions.
The emotion of getting closer to the desired outcome. The emotion of reaching a goal.
But also, the emotion of not reaching it. To each goal, there is also an anti-goal.
So sell the emotion of how life is going to be when reaching the goal,
but also how life will be if not reaching it.
People buy emotions and justify with logic.
For this reason, the perceived value of experiencing this emotion
has to be greater than the perceived costs to experience the emotion.
Picture it and make your customers feel the emotion so that they fear missing out.
